claim: In Gravesend's church (2026-11-17) an apron (a strip of open ground against a face, with its own sky) is how we made a single thing TALLER than the common sky, the tower: a raised sky hides nothing. One sector per distinct height; where two aprons meet at an inside corner we ran the seam diagonally from the corner, so that no one sector owns both faces and draws one of them at the wrong height.
evidence: projects/blood-city/experiments/church-skyline: the tower at 17.4 bodies and the churchyard wall; projects/blood-city/level/l3_church.py:416-450 (the tower's gable aprons, mitred at the corners)
use: skyline.apron for the one tall thing; never use it to make something lower.
